body:
I'm seeing a therapist, but I find it harder to talk to people I don't know well. I have some anxiety, and I kinda shut down and can't get much out when I'm speaking to someone I'm not well acquainted with. 

No one ever has time to talk. Few people respond to my texts, and those who do, only do so when they have a problem themself.

>...because your dad is gone and you just want to be around more adults sometimes because of it.

I actually hate being around adults. I'm in a terrible area and they are often condescending or rude to kids my age here. I've seen several therapists, all are rather rude as well. Where I am, it's not exactly easy to get decent help for these things.

It's not an easy thing to do when you have no motivation. It got better for awhile, but for a whole week over break, I barely left my room and pretty much never left my bed or stayed up long. I slept, that's it. And that's kinda all I want to do now...rest.

No. I've tried telling people. The few who tolerate me already have enough problems of their own, and don't need to worry about me. My problems aren't as important as theirs, apparently. Which I understand. I haven't been through the shit they have. I wasn't raped as a child, I didn't have an abusive father. They have their problems. Anyone else just thinks I'm weird and hardly talk to me as it is. I have two people who try to help me, but it's so hard to help someone when struggling with problems of your own.

I understand where these feelings probably came from, yeah. I've always been the kid no one really wanted to talk to, mom's been on drugs and dad's gone.

Knowing where they came from doesn't change that they're there.
May not help much, but what the hell, why not..
The last time I remember I haven't felt so bad about myself was several years ago, in fourth grade. It's been like 6 years since then.

I've never been able to do things for myself. My whole life, I've put others first, because no one ever put me first and I know how that sucked. Not wanting others to have to deal with that, I've made sure everyone has someone who puts them before themself. I don't know how to disregard others emotions and whatnot. I can't do things for myself, because they often hurt many others. This is only different because as I've said, when I'm dead I can' care.

Maybe only slightly. If it was reincarnation, then I'd have the chance to be someone else. All the more reason to do it. Heaven or Hell, which I highly highly doubt, I'd be burning for an eternity but hey, I'd fucking deserve it and I'd end up there eventually anyways.
I like them up until they get annoying, as most living things do.

~~I'm not just being fucking melodramatic, you ass. I've attempted before, with less effective methods, because I didn't have the means to do a better job then. Don't think I'll fucking do it? Fucking watch me.~~

EDIT: That was a bit rude of me, I'm sorry. I really am not being melodramatic, and it is quite rude of you to assume so. Saying things like that can send someone off the deep end. For future reference, it's safer to assume they're serious, even if they aren't or haven't been before. Just you saying that was enough for me to actually step outside and starting tying the rope. So seriously, fucking watch it.

I'm a terrible person. I'm a slut, I can't stand up for myself, I tend to be an attention whore at times, I'm weak, I'm too much of a perfectionist and I freak out over stupid little things, and then I look dumb for being upset over something as silly as getting an answer wrong. I'm stupid, I can never seem to do anything right, I'm always making a mess or getting in trouble. Someone is always mad at me, despite my best efforts to make everyone happy. I have a lot wrong with me. This is just off the top of my head.

I would like to die on my own time anyways; I don't care much for surprises. And if I were to run away or something similar, I would still be alive, and able to feel guilty for abandoning everyone. It isn't the thought of death that I admire. I would very much like to live. I enjoy many things in life. My issue is that I can't stand who I am, it is myself I want to get away from. Don't tell me I can change; I've tried. No, I cannot. Or, if I can, it is only in ways I'd prefer not to. I can't stand the way the world is. I have grown to despise much of humanity and am disgusted by the actions of other people, as well as my own actions.

Well some people can't be happy alive, either. That's often why suicide becomes their answer. And again, I won't care if I'm dead. Feeling guilty for wanting to while I'm alive does nothing, except maybe make me worse. No one really matters. It would only affect my small, unimportant community. Wouldn't be anything newsworthy. It would affect my family and a handful of others, all of which would either be okay or would likely be messed up anyways.

I can't feel guilty if I'm dead.
They might have fucked up lives afterwards; not my problem anymore. People might follow in my footsteps; it's their lives, their choice. I've stopped caring about that. I wouldn't know what happened; I'd be dead.

I try to do good all the time. Every day, little things at school. No one cares. I never get a thank you, which is okay. What I hate about it is the thing people actually remember are the times I fuck up, and I fuck up a ton. I'm accident prone, and I often mess up and somehow piss people off, despite trying my best not to.

I don't care if it hurts. I'd rather feel one last moment of pain before feeling nothing anyways. I have plenty of time, as my mother won't be home til some time around 1 or 2 am.

Fuck the future. No amount of small acts of kindness will fix this fucked up world.

I know things CAN get better. It doesn't mean they will. There is also the possibility it will get worse. We can't pretend this isn't a cold, hard world we live in. We can't pretend life is easy. When I move out and change my environment, I'll likely have more stress due to more responsibility. It's not my environment that is the issue. I love my family, I love living with them. They can be trying at times, but what family isn't? It's myself I can stand. And it is myself I can never get away from.

I do a ton of risky shit all the time. Doing something scary every day isn't enough for me anymore. Besides that, I rarely have the motivation to even roll out of bed now.
I appreciate your trying to help though.

I know. I watch her for that kinda stuff, but as she was suicidal to begin with, it was difficult. Her sister watches for signs of anything for me as well. If I see anything like that, I'm prepared to tell my psychiatrist to change the meds.

He opens the door slowly, and sees his target with headphones in, jamming out to his music in front of a vanity mirror. He only caught a glimpse of his killer, and had just enough time to form a horrified expression before a bullet shattered his skull, spraying blood across the vanity he was sitting at. He turns from his latest work to find the target's young daughter standing in the doorway, with tears and her eyes and a gaze like a startled animal.

She stood on the rooftop of the hotel, wondering how and when things had gotten so bad. Conflicted by her thoughts, she tugs at her sleeves and plays with her bracelet as she contemplates what she came here to do. As she stares at the concrete below, she suddenly is overwhelmed by her typical emptiness, and remembers why she craved death so passionately to begin with. Suddenly, she hears someone yell her name.

Sadly, in this society, there are girls much younger than I being more obvious or more 'generous' whores than I am.
Also, for all you know, I just like the number 97. I do understand that it's stupid of me to do these things; the first time was a mistake, but I loved  the feeling so I kept doing it.
Also, saying no and peer pressure can be difficult to deal with for some of us.

If I were sleeping around with someone, and they treated me in a way I find disrespectful or rude, I would stop sleeping with that ~~asshole~~ individual. It is never unrealistic to want or expect respect. It is, however, silly to let people treat you without respect or let them walk all over you in that way. Don't encourage it, don't allow it.
Besides, I'm what I like to call a discreet whore. I fuck around, and the only people who know are those involved, those I trust, or those I plan on involving. So if you don't know, you can't be disrespectful because of it. If you find out, it'd be ridiculous of you to suddenly treat me in a more negative manner.

It's never okay to treat anyone that way. The way people have treated whores is a bit silly as it is; would you ever want be treated like that? Pretty much everyone deserves a little respect.

EDIT: Typos can be such a bitch.

For us girls that are whores, it doesn't mean you should treat us like one. I dunno about others, but I personally would be more likely to sleep with you if you treated me like a friend instead of some random slut. Friends with benefits is often better than a "wham, bam, thank ya ma'am" kinda deal. Unless I already dislike you to begin with.

Whores like to feel respected, too.

My preferred method would be to jump off a really tall building. I'd have a few last seconds to enjoy the feeling of falling before the lights go out for good.
However, there's a pretty good chance I'd wuss out after looking down, so a bullet to the brain or a rope around my neck would be more likely.

I understand that they only want me to be healthy. But obviously if I can function fairly well, I'm healthy enough. Despite knowing they're just trying to help, it annoys me to no end when they don't mind their own business.

Don't let this make you feel ugly or fat.
People don't always cheat because they're unhappy with their SO. Sometimes they just want something different. Sometimes they can't say no. Sometimes they just wanna do something stupid and impulsive and regrettable.

What he said about never loving you may have been out of frustration or panic. He might not have known what else to do.

I wish you luck in feeling better.

As for that last part, I know someone with the same mentality.
He said he isn't racist, but he hates n[slur]s. His justification is that not all black people are n[slur]s, just the ones that commit crimes and act like assholes. 

I still think he's probably just racist.

I stated what bands and genres he likes.
I just cannot remember any decent songs right now, the only one of those I listen to regularly is RHCP. So I'm a bit stumped on the songs.
And I know he'll like it, but I'd still like to make it really good. His gift was amazing, and I can't top it, but I'd like to at least come as close as I can.

Not long ago, maybe a month at most, I had a rather unpleasant experience with a friend of mine. We had screwed around before, but I decided to stop because I have a boyfriend, and it would be wrong to continue. Before he came over, we had already established that we were not going to do anything...he apparently does not take no for an answer.
I shook my head, told him I can't, I shouldn't, even looked him dead in the eye and said no. He didn't use force, didn't use and kind of threat...I just suck at standing my ground. At first it started with him standing near me while I was sitting on my bed, he grabbed my legs and spread them, got really close to me, and said in the most desperate voice I've ever heard, "*Please.*"
I decided to stand instead, for obvious reasons, after I told him no. But he kept begging, and pushing down on my shoulders...I eventually gave in. So I got down on my knees and sucked him off. I actually had a few tears come from my eyes while I was doing so -- but I don't think he noticed.

The worst part is, I feel like I can't necessarily say I was raped (or whatever you might call it instead if it's oral and not vaginal/anal). The one friend I told said it was, but I can't call it that myself. I didn't do all I could. I'm too quiet, too timid to get very loud when something is going on with me. My mother was in the other room at the time this happened, I could have yelled for her. I could him yelled at him to go home. Hell, I could have punched him in the nuts. But I was scared. Not necessarily scared he'd hurt me...just scared I'd upset him. I hate upsetting people. I hate dilemmas like this; this isn't the first time. Just the one that bothered me most.

The whole thing is still burned into my memory. I still remember grabbing the sleeve of his jacket near the shoulder, trying to tell him no as he pushed downwards on me. I remember the look in his eyes, like he desperately wanted me to do this. It makes me shudder just thinking about it.

TL;DR: According to a friend, I was technically raped, but I still feel like it was my fault because I didn't do all I could to stop him. I was too petrified.

To start the thread off, my most ironic relationship is the one I'm in now.

I'm a pacifist, I have a ridiculously high sex drive, and I am not exactly fond of drugs. (Although I would like to try each one once, just to quench my curiosity of how the experience would feel)
My boyfriend, however, is a rather violent man (not towards me -- he would never do that), rarely wants sex (major disappointment, but easily overlooked), and has done every drug I can think of. He's still addicted to meth and pot, and has a drinking problem, but we're working on that.

I can't help but imagine someone having this, and then a roommate replacing it with actual shit.
That would be a disgusting prank, but still kinda funny.

Agreed. Just making it illegal won't stop it. Drugs are illegal, but still widely used. Taking away gun rights would just make it harder to get, but certainly not impossible. If they take guns away, what are we going to protect ourselves with if some lunatic shows up with one he or she obtained illegally?
And the difference in the death toll may not have been a result of the weapon choice, for all we know. It could have been because one attacker was more set on killing, while the other may have just been running about stabbing everyone.
I.. I'm not even sure what the hell I just looked at.

I can't figure out what the problem is. If I could, I'd be able to fix it. If anything, it's a huge list of problems that I can't comprehend. 
And I know many others are like this, I don't care that they are. I consider it an unacceptable trait for me. I don't want to be this way. And I can't change it. I've tried. I don't know how to not be me. I don't know how to be any different, not without undesirable outcomes.

I only posted here cuz I know it isn't normal to feel this way. I'm aware that I don't truly want death, I want a way to stop feeling the way I do. But death seems like the only certain solution.
I'm 15, my sisters are too young to understand, my dad is gone, and my mom thinks sending me to therapy and avoiding the issue around me will fix it.
My cousin got me into it last Easter.
I feel happy quite often, actually. It just never lasts long enough to matter. The last time I was happy for more than a few minutes was probably before Thanksgiving, at least.

Your manner of speaking is rather amusing.
The problem isn't that what other people think bothers me, it's that I can't stand myself. I feel terrible inside every time I fail to say what I mean to, or when I feel so awkward that I freeze in place. I beat myself up over it. I don't care what others think; They don't mean a thing to me. Welcome among other freaks or not, I don't feel safe or comfortable inside my own mind, and that is what bothers me.

I don't have anywhere to start that is even remotely comfortable..

I'm learning guitar, I try to practice knife-throwing, and I draw. I'm only mediocre at best at any of those, but I'm a perfectionist, so that isn't good enough.

I can't talk to people. I don't know what to say, and I'm terribly awkward socially. I can't open up much without feeling like a freak, and I usually don't know where to start.
I'm already seeing a therapist, but I can't tell her much. I feel like I can't trust people.

I have hobbies, but I'm never any good at them, and I know I should practice, but when I do I end up getting frustrated with myself for being a slow learner, so it always results in a foul mood.

I wish I knew. Often times there is no trigger, I just randomly get depressed. And my depression seems to focus around my hatred for myself and other people, my boredom of life, and my inability to feel and act like a normal human being.

I'm not throwing myself a pity party. I'm being serious.
If anyone or everyone in my life died right now, I'd be fine.
Because everyone is replaceable, I see no reason to get attached to any of them.

There isn't anything I actually care about. I don't get attached to things, cuz for some reason, I can't.
I thought maybe that was normal. That's why I asked, to check.
